rows.proposal_note: The delete must become an explicit invariant refusal, not a bare auth.kernel read: the field is optional (dispatch.ts:217) and the Run codec still accepts an absent authorization as a 'historical' Run (record-readers.ts:206-213; execution-entry-codecs.ts:129-134); only an old/foreign record can carry that shape and decision 79 rebuilds old data. Keep the kernel===null draft fallback (:2125-2134) unless separately proven dead: the codec admits a V2 auth whose kernel is null outside entering/entered (execution-entry-codecs.ts:108-116), so claude's 'likely unreachable' is not established.
